set.body:
Outcome
Make tab/header/minimized actions usable without mouse-only handlers.

Owned scope
views.scala; Dock.scala keyboard actions; dock.css; KeyboardSuite/ChromeSuite/TabMenuSuite/MinimizeFxSuite

Prerequisites
S3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tabs, close buttons, group actions, overflow and minimized strips expose correct role/name/state and actionable keyboard/assistive semantics.
- [ ] Keyboard users can select/close/reopen/minimize/maximize/pop out/dock back through documented actions or menus; hidden-hover chrome does not make actions unreachable.
- [ ] Preserve F6/Ctrl+Tab routing and let content-consumed keys remain consumed by content; Escape cancels drags and closes appropriate transient UI.
- [ ] Focus indication remains visible on selected/inactive states and returns to a live appropriate target after close/dock/perspective transitions.
- [ ] Retain accessible selection notifications and close veto/async admission; role/name assignment alone is not treated as complete accessibility proof.

Required evidence
Automated action/focus/routing assertions and bounded native assistive-technology probes; no regression in existing keyboard/close suites.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S4. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [S4] Complete keyboard and accessible actions for custom docking chrome
